description: This file is a shell script used to test Git merge behaviors, particularly for merging binary files with different strategies (resolve and recursive). It sets up test repositories, performs commits, and checks merge outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, takes a description and a sequence of commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to simulate time passing for commits.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail, used for testing failure conditions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs to verify they are identical.
